fields.name: source port
fields.description: optional field indicating the sending process's port, used for reply addressing if no other information is available.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: field indicating the port of the intended recipient.

fields.name: length
fields.description: specifies the total length of the udp datagram in bytes, including the udp header and data.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: provides error-checking coverage for the udp datagram, including header and payload.
